milestone: Host Here Disclosure Note Reworded — "Cover" Was Never a Special Category
slice: A real, immediate follow-up to the just-shipped Host Here disclosure note -- 'what does this mean. personal experience can only ever host in cover ?? personal experience is bound to one single scene but that can be any scene.' Confirmed to be a genuine wording ambiguity, not a data bug: scenes[0].name in _renderExperienceAttachPicker is fully dynamic, always reading the real name of the ONE Scene this specific Experience's own scopeSceneId points at -- in this World that Scene genuinely happens to be named 'Cover' (a Storybook-template starter Scene). The original phrasing ('it can only ever host in Cover, the Scene it belongs to') read as if 'Cover' were a fixed rule every Personal Experience must obey, rather than the plain fact that this one Experience's own binding happens to be a Scene called that. Fixed by reworded copy leading with the general rule before naming the specific instance: 'Personal Experiences are permanently bound to one Scene each -- whichever Scene they were created in. This one belongs to X, so it can never host anywhere else, even in a Scene you add later.' Verified via the existing scene_dropdown_repro3.js suite (14/14, its own disclosure-note assertion updated to match) and both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2), all passing unchanged. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Creator Governing Rules change; confined to tools/world-builder-v2/js/worldBuilderApp.js.
